description: Head-movement mini-game GA23, Wave 2 Group E (precision control): paced-turn game. Six fixed turns alternate left and right; each turn is timed from leaving the center zone (past 10 degrees toward the called side) to reaching the 27-degree edge, and counts only inside a 3.0-5.0 second pace window. Faster than 3 seconds, slower than 5 seconds, wrong side past 15 degrees, or backing off before the edge all fail the turn. Return to center gates every next call. A one-prompt start calibration (turn left once) learns which yaw sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: pace-turn
